guidelines.detail: refines FID-02 (The description distinguishes a human action from automatic system behavior, while the reference includes flows to automated activities that are absent from the generated model. FID-02 already addresses preserving separately described actions and dependencies; this guideline specifies how to apply it when the description distinguishes automated behavior from human action. It does not prescribe par)

same as LRN-016 (The description says users input values, machine values are collected and shown, and additional questions depend on results. The label pairs show semantic differences, including unsupported specificity in the reference label for the decision. This supports faithful, description-grounded labels, which is already captured by learned guideline LRN-016.)

same as LRN-052 (The missing-flow records show omitted transitions between activities and from activities to decision points, despite the description specifying their order. This is already essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-052.)

The description says only that whether additional questions are asked depends on unspecified results. The reference gateway labels introduce specific criteria about cap position and fill level that the description does not state, so they cannot support a guideline for reproducing those labels.

same as LRN-052 (The records show multiple reference sequence flows absent from the generated model, while the description establishes an activity order and conditional continuation. LRN-052 already expresses essentially the same guidance.)

refines FID-01 (The description says additional questions may or may not be asked depending on an evaluation, but gives no criterion. The generated gateway label introduces a specific criterion not stated in the description. This refines FID-01 by specifying how to label a decision when its criterion is unstated.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly states that an automated system performs one or more actions during a process, alongside any human actions.: Model each stated automated action as a separate activity from any human action, and connect the activities according to the dependencies stated in the description.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly states that an automated system performs one or more actions during a process, alongside any human actions.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome and specifies what it involves

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description specifies successive activities or a transition into or out of a decision or synchronization point: Connect the corresponding flow nodes with sequence flows so the modeled paths preserve the described order and branch continuation.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that activities occur in a particular order, including an activity following a start event or leading to a decision point

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says whether follow-up work occurs depends on an evaluation, but does not state the decision criterion: Label the decision gateway only with the stated dependency; do not name an unstated criterion or outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says whether follow-up work occurs depends on an evaluation, but does not state the decision criterion
